name: Evidence Vault
summary: Evidence Vault is a calm first-person game about the night shift in a small-town police evidence archive. The upstairs archive of the Morrow Creek Police Department hasn't been filed properly in years, and loose papers, photographs, cassettes and evidence bags lie all over the floor. Each piece belongs to a case from 1974 to 1989. You work out which one, sometimes by brushing off grime, reading invisible ink under a UV lamp or X-raying a sealed bag. Then you wrap the file, press it, stamp it APPROVED and slide its carton onto the shelf for its year. There is no timer, no quota and no way to fail.
